### Forró (73)

- [Luiz Gonzaga](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/luiz-gonzaga.html): Solo · Pernambuco · debut 1941 · tier S (Legend). Baião, Xote and xaxado. The "King of Baião": "Asa Branca" (1947), "Baião", "Olha pro Céu"; invented the accordion, zabumba and triangle trio.
- [Jackson do Pandeiro](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/jackson-do-pandeiro.html): Solo · Paraíba · debut 1953 · tier S (Legend). Pé-de-serra forró, Coco and ciranda. The "King of Rhythm": coco, forró and swing; "Chiclete com Banana".
- [Dominguinhos](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/dominguinhos.html): Solo · Pernambuco · debut 1964 · tier S (Legend). Pé-de-serra forró, Baião. Gonzaga's heir on the accordion: "Eu Só Quero um Xodó", "Isso Aqui Tá Bom Demais".
- [Mastruz com Leite](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/mastruz-com-leite.html): Band · Ceará · debut 1990 · tier S (Legend). Electronic forró. Founded forró eletrônico in Fortaleza, with the SomZoom label.
- [Wesley Safadão](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/wesley-safadao.html): Solo · Ceará · debut 2007 · tier S (Legend). Electronic forró, Sertanejo universitário, Forronejo. From Garota Safada to the biggest name in forró eletrônico: "Camarote", "Ar Condicionado no 15".
- [Sivuca](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/sivuca.html): Solo · Paraíba · debut 1950 · tier A (Giant). Pé-de-serra forró, Brazilian jazz. Accordionist and arranger from forró to jazz: "Feira de Mangaio".
- [Trio Nordestino](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/trio-nordestino.html): Band · Bahia · debut 1958 · tier A (Giant). Pé-de-serra forró, Xote and xaxado. "Forró Pesado", "Procurando Tu".
- [Elba Ramalho](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/elba-ramalho.html): Solo · Paraíba · debut 1979 · tier A (Giant). Pé-de-serra forró, Festival-era MPB. The voice of forró and northeastern MPB: "Banho de Cheiro", "Bate Coração".
- [Calcinha Preta](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/calcinha-preta.html): Band · Sergipe · debut 1995 · tier A (Giant). Electronic forró. "Você Não Vale Nada"; romantic electronic forró.
- [Falamansa](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/falamansa.html): Band · São Paulo · debut 1998 · tier A (Giant). Forró universitário. São Paulo university forró: "Xote da Alegria", "Rindo à Toa".
- [Aviões do Forró](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/avioes-do-forro.html): Band · Ceará · debut 2002 · tier A (Giant). Electronic forró. Xand Avião and Solange Almeida; a 2000s–10s phenomenon.
- [Barões da Pisadinha](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/baroes-da-pisadinha.html): Band · Bahia · debut 2015 · tier A (Giant). Piseiro. "Recairei", "Basta Você Me Ligar": piseiro sweeps the country in the pandemic.
- [João Gomes](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/joao-gomes.html): Solo · Pernambuco · debut 2020 · tier A (Giant). Piseiro. "Meu Pedaço de Pecado", "Dengo"; romantic piseiro.
- [Garota Safada](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/garota-safada.html): Band · Ceará · tier A (Giant). Electronic forró. The electronic forró band that launched Wesley Safadão.
- [João do Vale](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/joao-do-vale.html): Solo · Maranhão · tier A (Giant). Baião. A songwriter from Maranhão, of "Carcará" and "Pisa na Fulô".
- [Léo Foguete](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/leo-foguete.html): Solo · Paraíba · tier A (Giant). Piseiro. Piseiro and arrocha that exploded on the platforms in 2024.
- [Mari Fernandez](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/mari-fernandez.html): Solo · Ceará · tier A (Giant). Piseiro, Electronic forró. The female voice of piseiro in the 2020s.
- [Natanzinho Lima](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/natanzinho-lima.html): Solo · tier A (Giant). Piseiro. Romantic piseiro of the 2020s.
- [Nattan](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/nattan.html): Solo · Ceará · tier A (Giant). Piseiro, Electronic forró. Forró and piseiro from Ceará, among the most streamed of the 2020s.
- [Banda de Pífanos Zabumba de Caruaru](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/banda-de-pifanos-zabumba-de-caruaru.html): Group · debut 1924 · tier B (Reference). Baião. Nominated for the Latin Grammy for Best Portuguese Language Roots Album.
- [Marinês](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/marines.html): Solo · Pernambuco · debut 1955 · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró, Xote and xaxado. The "Queen of Xaxado".
- [Genival Lacerda](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/genival-lacerda.html): Solo · Paraíba · debut 1960 · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. "Severina Xique-Xique".
- [Oswaldinho do Acordeon](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/oswaldinho-do-acordeon.html): Solo · Rio de Janeiro · debut 1960 · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Accordionist of forró and choro.
- [Anastácia](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/anastacia.html): Solo · Pernambuco · debut 1970 · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Dominguinhos's co-writer: "Eu Só Quero um Xodó".
- [Flávio José](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/flavio-jose.html): Solo · Paraíba · debut 1980 · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Traditional forró from Paraíba.
- [Mestre Ambrósio](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/mestre-ambrosio.html): Band · Pernambuco · debut 1992 · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró, Manguebeat. Rabeca and forró in the manguebeat generation.
- [Limão com Mel](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/limao-com-mel.html): Band · Pernambuco · debut 1993 · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Forró eletrônico from Pernambuco.
- [Magníficos](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/magnificos.html): Band · Paraíba · debut 1995 · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Electronic forró from Paraíba: "Me Usa".
- [Rastapé](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/rastape.html): Band · São Paulo · debut 1999 · tier B (Reference). Forró universitário. University forró.
- [Solange Almeida](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/solange-almeida.html): Solo · Ceará · debut 2002 · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Formerly of Aviões do Forró.
- [Xand Avião](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/xand-aviao.html): Solo · Ceará · debut 2002 · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Former Aviões do Forró, solo career.
- [Mestrinho](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/mestrinho.html): Solo · Sergipe · debut 2005 · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Accordionist from Dominguinhos to Maria Bethânia.
- [Tarcísio do Acordeon](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/tarcisio-do-acordeon.html): Solo · Ceará · debut 2020 · tier B (Reference). Piseiro. "Cabeça Branca" with João Gomes.
- [Zé Vaqueiro](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/ze-vaqueiro.html): Solo · Pernambuco · debut 2020 · tier B (Reference). Piseiro. "Volta Comigo BB", "Letícia".
- [Alcymar Monteiro](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/alcymar-monteiro.html): Solo · Pernambuco · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Pernambuco forró singer.
- [Bicho de Pé](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/bicho-de-pe.html): Band · São Paulo · tier B (Reference). Forró universitário. São Paulo band of 2000s forró universitário.
- [Bonde do Forró](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/bonde-do-forro.html): Band · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. A 2000s electronic forró band.
- [Cavaleiros do Forró](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/cavaleiros-do-forro.html): Band · Rio Grande do Norte · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Electronic forró band from Rio Grande do Norte.
- [Dorgival Dantas](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/dorgival-dantas.html): Solo · Rio Grande do Norte · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Composer of forró hits such as "Você Não Vale Nada".
- [Eric Land](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/eric-land.html): Solo · tier B (Reference). Piseiro. Piseiro singer of "Pilantra e Meio", with Natanzinho Lima.
- [Felipe Amorim](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/felipe-amorim.html): Solo · Ceará · tier B (Reference). Piseiro. Piseiro from Ceará.
- [Filho do Piseiro](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/filho-do-piseiro.html): Solo · Amazonas · tier B (Reference). Piseiro. A piseiro singer from Manaus who went viral on Instagram.
- [Forroçacana](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/forrocacana.html): Band · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Nominated for the Latin Grammy for Best Portuguese Language Roots Album.
- [Forró do Muído](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/forro-do-muido.html): Band · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. A 2000s electronic forró band.
- [Frank Aguiar](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/frank-aguiar.html): Solo · Piauí · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Electronic forró's "little keyboard dog".
- [Gabriel Diniz](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/gabriel-diniz.html): Solo · Mato Grosso do Sul · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. "Jenifer" (2018), with the chorus "o nome dela é Jenifer" ("her name is Jenifer"), was one of the biggest hits of 2019; he died in a plane crash in 2019.
- [Henry Freitas](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/henry-freitas.html): Solo · tier B (Reference). Piseiro. Piseiro singer of "Tando".
- [Iguinho e Lulinha](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/iguinho-e-lulinha.html): Duo · tier B (Reference). Piseiro. A 2020s piseiro duo.
- [Japãozin](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/japaozin.html): Solo · tier B (Reference). Piseiro. Piseiro of the 2020s.
- [Jonas Esticado](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/jonas-esticado.html): Solo · Ceará · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Forró singer from Ceará.
- [Jorge de Altinho](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/jorge-de-altinho.html): Solo · Pernambuco · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Pernambuco forró singer-songwriter.
- [Lucy Alves](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/lucy-alves.html): Solo · Paraíba · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Accordionist and singer from Paraíba.
- [Mano Walter](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/mano-walter.html): Solo · Alagoas · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró, Sertanejo universitário. Cowboy singer from Alagoas, between forró and sertanejo.
- [Manu Bahtidão](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/manu-bahtidao.html): Solo · Alagoas · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. "Daqui Pra Sempre" (2023), with Simone Mendes, topped the Billboard Brasil chart.
- [Michele Andrade](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/michele-andrade.html): Solo · Pernambuco · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. A singer and instrumentalist from Pernambuco of the new forró generation.
- [Márcia Fellipe](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/marcia-fellipe.html): Solo · Amazonas · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. An electronic-forró voice from Amazonas.
- [Nando Cordel](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/nando-cordel.html): Solo · Pernambuco · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Composer of "Gostoso Demais", with Dominguinhos.
- [Os 3 do Nordeste](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/os-3-do-nordeste.html): Group · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. A classic pé-de-serra forró trio.
- [Petrúcio Amorim](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/petrucio-amorim.html): Solo · Pernambuco · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Pernambuco composer of forró classics.
- [Raphaela Santos](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/raphaela-santos.html): Solo · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Electronic forró singer known as "A Favorita".
- [Rey Vaqueiro](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/rey-vaqueiro.html): Solo · São Paulo · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Vaquejada forró, launched from Rio Grande do Norte.
- [Saia Rodada](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/saia-rodada.html): Band · Rio Grande do Norte · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Electronic forró band from Rio Grande do Norte.
- [Santanna o Cantador](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/santanna-o-cantador.html): Solo · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Pé-de-serra forró singer-songwriter.
- [Solteirões do Forró](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/solteiroes-do-forro.html): Band · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. A 2000s electronic forró band.
- [Stefhany](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/stefhany.html): Solo · São Paulo · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Went viral in 2009 with "Eu Sou Stefhany", the Crossfox song.
- [Targino Gondim](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/targino-gondim.html): Solo · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Accordionist from Juazeiro, co-writer of "Esperando na Janela".
- [Taty Girl](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/taty-girl.html): Solo · Ceará · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Electronic forró singer from Ceará.
- [Thullio Milionário](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/thullio-milionario.html): Solo · Rio Grande do Norte · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. A singer from Natal in the vaquejada style of forró: "Casca de Bala" (2024) reached number 8 on the Billboard Brasil Hot 100.
- [Toque Dez](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/toque-dez.html): Band · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Electronic forró band.
- [Trio Virgulino](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/trio-virgulino.html): Group · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Nominated for the Latin Grammy for Best Portuguese Language Roots Album.
- [Vitor Fernandes](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/vitor-fernandes.html): Solo · tier B (Reference). Piseiro. A 2020s piseiro singer.
- [Waldonys](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/waldonys.html): Solo · Ceará · tier B (Reference). Pé-de-serra forró. Accordionist from Ceará.
- [Zé Cantor](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/ze-cantor.html): Solo · tier B (Reference). Electronic forró. Electronic forró singer.

### Axé and Bahian Music (64)

- [Dodô & Osmar](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/dodo-e-osmar.html): Duo · Bahia · debut 1950 · tier S (Legend). Trio elétrico. Invented the trio elétrico and the guitarra baiana at the 1950 carnival.
- [Olodum](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/olodum.html): Collective · Bahia · debut 1979 · tier S (Legend). Samba-reggae and afro blocos. Created samba-reggae in Pelourinho; recorded with Paul Simon and Michael Jackson ("They Don't Care About Us").
- [Chiclete com Banana](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/chiclete-com-banana.html): Band · Bahia · debut 1980 · tier S (Legend). Axé music, Trio elétrico. Bell Marques and Salvador carnival's most beloved trio elétrico.
- [Luiz Caldas](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/luiz-caldas.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 1985 · tier S (Legend). Axé music. "Fricote" (1985): the song that opened axé.
- [Daniela Mercury](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/daniela-mercury.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 1986 · tier S (Legend). Axé music, Samba-reggae and afro blocos. "O Canto da Cidade" (1992) took axé nationwide; "Swing da Cor", "Rapunzel".
- [É o Tchan](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/e-o-tchan.html): Band · Bahia · debut 1992 · tier S (Legend). Pagode baiano. Choreographies and "Segura o Tchan": 1990s pagode baiano.
- [Ivete Sangalo](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/ivete-sangalo.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 1993 · tier S (Legend). Axé music, Contemporary pop. From Banda Eva to axé's biggest star: "Sorte Grande", "Festa", "Quando a Chuva Passar".
- [Carlinhos Brown](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/carlinhos-brown.html): Solo · Bahia · tier S (Legend). Samba-reggae and afro blocos, Axé music. Percussionist, composer and producer; Timbalada and Tribalistas; "Maria Caipirinha".
- [Filhos de Gandhy](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/filhos-de-gandhy.html): Collective · Bahia · debut 1949 · tier A (Giant). Afoxé and ijexá. Afoxé founded by dockworkers in 1949, the great white-clad procession of Salvador carnival.
- [Ilê Aiyê](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/ile-aiye.html): Collective · Bahia · debut 1974 · tier A (Giant). Samba-reggae and afro blocos. Salvador's first afro bloco, of Black affirmation.
- [Banda Eva](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/banda-eva.html): Band · Bahia · debut 1980 · tier A (Giant). Axé music. Revealed Ivete Sangalo; "Beleza Rara".
- [Asa de Águia](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/asa-de-aguia.html): Band · Bahia · debut 1987 · tier A (Giant). Axé music. Durval Lelys; "Cavalo Manco", "Bate Lata".
- [Margareth Menezes](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/margareth-menezes.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 1988 · tier A (Giant). Axé music, Samba-reggae and afro blocos. "Faraó", "Elegibô"; Minister of Culture since 2023.
- [Timbalada](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/timbalada.html): Collective · Bahia · debut 1991 · tier A (Giant). Samba-reggae and afro blocos, Axé music. Carlinhos Brown and the timbaus of Candeal: "Beija-Flor", "Margarida Perfumada".
- [Harmonia do Samba](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/harmonia-do-samba.html): Band · Bahia · debut 1993 · tier A (Giant). Pagode baiano. Xanddy; "Vem Neném".
- [Psirico](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/psirico.html): Band · Bahia · debut 2001 · tier A (Giant). Pagode baiano. Márcio Victor; "Lepo Lepo" (2013) went global.
- [Claudia Leitte](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/claudia-leitte.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 2002 · tier A (Giant). Axé music, Contemporary pop. From Babado Novo to a solo career; a coach on The Voice.
- [Pablo](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/pablo.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 2005 · tier A (Giant). Arrocha. The "King of Arrocha": "Fui Fiel", "Porque Homem Não Chora".
- [Léo Santana](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/leo-santana.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 2007 · tier A (Giant). Pagode baiano. Formerly of Parangolé; "Santinha", "Zona de Perigo".
- [BaianaSystem](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/baianasystem.html): Band · Bahia · debut 2009 · tier A (Giant). Axé music, National reggae. Guitarra baiana, dub and activism: "Playsom", "Lucro (Descomprimindo)".
- [Bell Marques](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/bell-marques.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 2014 · tier A (Giant). Axé music. Chiclete com Banana's voice for over three decades, solo since 2014.
- [Banda Mel](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/banda-mel.html): Band · Bahia · tier A (Giant). Axé music, Samba-reggae and afro blocos. Bahian band of "Prefixo de Verão".
- [Araketu](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/araketu.html): Band · Bahia · debut 1980 · tier B (Reference). Axé music, Samba-reggae and afro blocos. "Mal Acostumado"; from afro bloco to pop.
- [Cheiro de Amor](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/cheiro-de-amor.html): Band · Bahia · debut 1980 · tier B (Reference). Axé music. Carla Visi, later Alinne Rosa.
- [Netinho](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/netinho.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 1991 · tier B (Reference). Axé music. "Milla", "Preta".
- [As Meninas](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/as-meninas.html): Group · Bahia · debut 1997 · tier B (Reference). Axé music. "Xibom Bombom" (1999).
- [Axé Blond](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/axe-blond.html): Group · Bahia · debut 1999 · tier B (Reference). Axé music. "Pancadão".
- [Parangolé](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/parangole.html): Band · Bahia · debut 2000 · tier B (Reference). Pagode baiano. Pagode baiano.
- [Babado Novo](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/babado-novo.html): Band · Bahia · debut 2001 · tier B (Reference). Axé music. Revealed Claudia Leitte.
- [Tierry](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/tierry.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 2010 · tier B (Reference). Arrocha, Sertanejo universitário. "Rita", "Cracudo".
- [Saulo Fernandes](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/saulo-fernandes.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 2013 · tier B (Reference). Axé music. Formerly of Banda Eva, now solo.
- [Vingadora](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/vingadora.html): Band · Bahia · debut 2014 · tier B (Reference). Arrochadeira. An Itabuna band mixing arrocha and pagode baiano: "Paredão Metralhadora".
- [Rachel Reis](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/rachel-reis.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 2021 · tier B (Reference). Pagode baiano. Pagodão and Bahian MPB; the album "Meu Esquema" (2022).
- [Banda Beijo](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/banda-beijo.html): Band · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Axé music. An axé band that had Netinho as its singer.
- [Banda Reflexu's](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/banda-reflexu-s.html): Band · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Axé music. Bahian band of "Madagascar Olodum".
- [Black Style](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/black-style.html): Band · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Pagode baiano. A pagode baiano group.
- [Companhia do Pagode](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/companhia-do-pagode.html): Band · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Pagode baiano. A 1990s pagode baiano group.
- [Durval Lélys](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/durval-lelys.html): Solo · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Axé music. Founder and voice of Asa de Águia.
- [Fantasmão](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/fantasmao.html): Band · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Pagode baiano. A pagode baiano group.
- [Gera Samba](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/gera-samba.html): Band · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Pagode baiano. The pagode baiano group that became É o Tchan.
- [Gerônimo](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/geronimo.html): Solo · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Axé music, Afoxé and ijexá. Singer-songwriter of "É d'Oxum".
- [Gilmelândia](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/gilmelandia.html): Solo · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Axé music. Ex-Banda Beijo; "Maionese" and "Chegou o Verão".
- [Igor Kannário](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/igor-kannario.html): Solo · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Pagode baiano. Pagodão's "Prince of the Ghetto".
- [J. Eskine](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/j-eskine.html): Solo · tier B (Reference). Arrocha. Singer of "Resenha do Arrocha", among the most-played songs of 2025.
- [Jammil](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/jammil.html): Band · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Axé music. A 2000s axé band.
- [Ju Moraes](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/ju-moraes.html): Solo · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Axé music. A singer from Salvador and a finalist on The Voice Brasil 2012; solo ever since, she signed with Universal Music in 2013.
- [La Fúria](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/la-furia.html): Band · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Pagode baiano. A pagode baiano group.
- [Lazzo Matumbi](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/lazzo-matumbi.html): Solo · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Samba-reggae and afro blocos, National reggae. Bahian singer of samba-reggae and Black music.
- [Muzenza](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/muzenza.html): Group · Bahia · tier B (Reference). Samba-reggae and afro blocos. An afro bloco from Salvador.

### Brazilian Pop (88)

- [Sandy & Junior](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/sandy-e-junior.html): Duo · São Paulo · debut 1989 · tier S (Legend). Teen pop. The sibling duo that ruled 1990s–2000s teen pop.
- [Rouge](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/rouge.html): Group · São Paulo · debut 2002 · tier S (Legend). Teen pop. Born on Popstars (SBT), Brazil's biggest girl group: "Ragatanga", "Um Anjo Veio Me Falar"; reunited in 2017.
- [Pabllo Vittar](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/pabllo-vittar.html): Solo · Maranhão · debut 2014 · tier S (Legend). Contemporary pop, LGBTQIA+ pop. The most streamed drag queen in the world: "K.O.", "Sua Cara", "Corpo Sensual".
- [Iza](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/iza.html): Solo · Rio de Janeiro · debut 2016 · tier S (Legend). Contemporary pop, Neo-soul and R&B. "Pesadão", "Dona de Mim"; a coach on The Voice Brasil.
- [Frenéticas](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/freneticas.html): Group · Rio de Janeiro · debut 1977 · tier A (Giant). Disco and dance-pop. Six women from the Frenetic Dancing Days disco: "Perigosa", "Dancin' Days".
- [Gretchen](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/gretchen.html): Solo · Rio de Janeiro · debut 1978 · tier A (Giant). Disco and dance-pop. "Freak Le Boom Boom" and "Conga Conga Conga"; an internet icon.
- [Dominó](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/domino.html): Group · São Paulo · debut 1984 · tier A (Giant). Teen pop. Brazil's first big boy band, created by Gugu Liberato.
- [KLB](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/klb.html): Group · São Paulo · debut 2000 · tier A (Giant). Teen pop. Brothers Kiko, Leandro and Bruno: "A Dor Desse Amor".
- [Sandy](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/sandy.html): Solo · São Paulo · debut 2010 · tier A (Giant). Contemporary pop, Teen pop. From Sandy & Junior to a solo career: "Me Espera", "Areia".
- [Luísa Sonza](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/luisa-sonza.html): Solo · Rio Grande do Sul · debut 2014 · tier A (Giant). Contemporary pop. "Braba", "Chico", "Café da Manhã"; album "Escândalo Íntimo" (2023).
- [Jão](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/jao.html): Solo · São Paulo · debut 2016 · tier A (Giant). Alternative pop. "Idiota", "Pirata", "Me Lambe"; stadium tours in the 2020s.

### Brega, Calypso and Sounds of Pará (54)

- [Reginaldo Rossi](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/reginaldo-rossi.html): Solo · Pernambuco · debut 1964 · tier S (Legend). Romantic brega. The "King of Brega": "Garçom" (1987), "A Raposa e as Uvas".
- [Pinduca](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/pinduca.html): Solo · Pará · debut 1973 · tier S (Legend). Carimbó. The "King of Carimbó": "Sinhá Pureza".
- [Banda Calypso](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/banda-calypso.html): Band · Pará · debut 1999 · tier S (Legend). Pará calypso. Joelma and Chimbinha: from Pará to the whole country with millions of independent copies.
- [Gaby Amarantos](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/gaby-amarantos.html): Solo · Pará · debut 2000 · tier S (Legend). Tecnobrega. The "Beyoncé of Pará": "Ex Mai Love", soap theme in 2012; a coach on The Voice.
- [Waldick Soriano](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/waldick-soriano.html): Solo · Bahia · debut 1960 · tier A (Giant). Romantic brega. "Eu Não Sou Cachorro, Não" (1972).
- [Odair José](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/odair-jose.html): Solo · Goiás · debut 1970 · tier A (Giant). Romantic brega. "Pare de Tomar a Pílula", censored by the dictatorship.
- [Wando](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/wando.html): Solo · Minas Gerais · debut 1973 · tier A (Giant). Romantic brega. "Fogo e Paixão", "Moça"; the underwear thrown on stage.

- [Agnaldo Rayol](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/agnaldo-rayol.html): Solo · Rio de Janeiro · tier A (Giant). Romantic brega. Tenor and romantic singer, a TV star in the 1960s.

- [Evaldo Braga](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/evaldo-braga.html): Solo · Rio de Janeiro · tier A (Giant). Romantic brega. "The Black idol", of "Sorria, Sorria", killed in an accident in 1973.

### Gospel and Religious Music (74)

- [Aline Barros](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/aline-barros.html): Solo · Rio de Janeiro · debut 1992 · tier S (Legend). Worship. The country's biggest gospel singer; Latin Grammys; "Ressuscita-me".
- [Diante do Trono](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/diante-do-trono.html): Collective · Minas Gerais · debut 1998 · tier S (Legend). Worship. Ana Paula Valadão; the world's largest gospel recording in 2003 (2 million people).
- [Padre Marcelo Rossi](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/padre-marcelo-rossi.html): Solo · São Paulo · debut 1998 · tier S (Legend). Catholic music. "Músicas para Louvar ao Senhor" (1998) sold over 3 million; the "Lord's aerobics".
- [Padre Zezinho](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/padre-zezinho.html): Solo · São Paulo · debut 1966 · tier A (Giant). Catholic music. A pioneer of Catholic song: "Oração pela Família".
- [Cassiane](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/cassiane.html): Solo · Rio de Janeiro · debut 1980 · tier A (Giant). Pentecostal gospel. The "queen of gospel music": "Hino da Vitória".

### Electronic (39)

- [DJ Marky](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/dj-marky.html): DJ · São Paulo · debut 1990 · tier S (Legend). Brazilian drum'n'bass. Took Brazilian drum'n'bass to London: "LK" (2002) with XRS.
- [Alok](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/alok.html): DJ · Goiás · debut 2010 · tier S (Legend). Brazilian bass. The world's most streamed Brazilian DJ: "Hear Me Now" (2016), "Deep Down".
- [Suba](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/suba.html): Solo · São Paulo · debut 1990 · tier A (Giant). Electronics and funk, New MPB. Serbian based in São Paulo; "São Paulo Confessions" (1999) and Bebel Gilberto's production.
- [DJ Patife](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/dj-patife.html): DJ · São Paulo · debut 1995 · tier A (Giant). Brazilian drum'n'bass. São Paulo drum'n'bass, "Sambassim" with Fernanda Porto.
- [Fernanda Porto](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/fernanda-porto.html): Solo · São Paulo · debut 2002 · tier A (Giant). Brazilian drum'n'bass, New MPB. "Sambassim" joined MPB and drum'n'bass.
- [Vintage Culture](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/vintage-culture.html): DJ · Mato Grosso do Sul · debut 2012 · tier A (Giant). Brazilian bass. Brazilian bass and house with a global presence.
- [Mamelo Sound System](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/mamelo-sound-system.html): Collective · São Paulo · debut 1998 · tier B (Reference). Electronics and funk, Rap nacional. São Paulo electronics and rap.
- [XRS](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/xrs.html): DJ · São Paulo · debut 1998 · tier B (Reference). Brazilian drum'n'bass. Marky's partner on "LK".
- [Bonde do Rolê](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/bonde-do-role.html): Band · Paraná · debut 2005 · tier B (Reference). Electronics and funk. Funk carioca and electronics released by Domino, with Diplo.
- [Gui Boratto](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/gui-boratto.html): DJ · São Paulo · debut 2005 · tier B (Reference). House and techno. Melodic techno on Kompakt: "Chromophobia" (2007).
- [Tropkillaz](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/tropkillaz.html): Duo · São Paulo · debut 2011 · tier B (Reference). Electronics and funk, Funk pop. Producers of "Vai Malandra"; electronics and funk abroad.
- [Omulu](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/omulu.html): DJ · Rio de Janeiro · debut 2012 · tier B (Reference). Electronics and funk, Rasteirinha. Funk and experimental electronics.
- [Dubdogs](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/dubdogs.html): Duo · São Paulo · debut 2013 · tier B (Reference). Brazilian bass. Brazilian bass.

- [KVSH](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/kvsh.html): DJ · São Paulo · debut 2016 · tier B (Reference). Brazilian bass. Brazilian bass.
- [Anderson Noise](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/anderson-noise.html): DJ · Minas Gerais · tier B (Reference). House and techno. Techno DJ from Minas Gerais.

- [Elekfantz](https://brazilianmusic.biblioverse.org/artists/elekfantz.html): Duo · tier B (Reference). House and techno. An electronic music duo.
